title: Travel and directions: ¿cómo llego a…?
summary: Buy a ticket, check into a hotel, ask the way and give directions with the imperative.
focus: Travel vocabulary and asking for and giving directions
content:
## At the station and the airport

At the ticket office (**la taquilla**) or the machine:

- *Un billete para Valencia, por favor.* (A ticket to Valencia, please.)
- *¿De ida o de ida y vuelta?* (Single or return?)
- *¿Para qué hora?* (For what time?)
- *¿De qué andén sale?* (Which platform does it leave from?)

**El billete de ida** is a single, **de ida y vuelta** a return. The train leaves from **el andén** (platform); the board shows **el destino** (destination) and **el retraso** (delay), if there is one.

At **el aeropuerto** you **facturas la maleta** (check in your suitcase), get **la tarjeta de embarque** (boarding pass) and wait at **la puerta de embarque** (gate) for **el vuelo** (flight).

## At the hotel

At reception (**la recepción**) you will say or hear:

- *Tengo una reserva a nombre de García.* (I have a booking in the name of García.)
- *Quería una habitación doble con baño para dos noches.* (I'd like a double room with a bathroom for two nights.)
- *¿Una habitación individual o doble?* (A single or a double room?)
- *¿El desayuno está incluido?* (Is breakfast included?)
- *¿A qué hora hay que dejar la habitación?* (What time is check-out?)

Note **a nombre de** (in the name of) and **para dos noches** (for two nights): **para** marks the stay you are paying for.

## Asking the way

Stop someone politely with **perdone** (usted) or **perdona** (tú), then ask:

- *¿Cómo llego a la estación?* (How do I get to the station?)
- *¿Dónde está el museo?* (Where is the museum?)
- *¿Hay una farmacia por aquí?* (Is there a chemist's around here?)
- *¿Está lejos?* (Is it far?)

Distance is **está a** + time or metres: *Está a cinco minutos a pie.* *Está a doscientos metros.* *Está a dos calles de aquí.*

To place things, use these phrases, all followed by **de**:

| phrase | meaning |
|---|---|
| **al lado de** | next to |
| **enfrente de** | opposite |
| **al final de** | at the end of |
| **en la esquina de** | on the corner of |
| **a la derecha / a la izquierda de** | to the right / left of |

## Giving directions with the imperative

Directions are commands, so they use the imperative. Use the **tú** form with a friend and the **usted** form with a stranger:

| tú | usted | meaning |
|---|---|---|
| **sigue** todo recto | **siga** todo recto | go straight on |
| **gira** a la derecha | **gire** a la derecha | turn right |
| **cruza** la plaza | **cruce** la plaza | cross the square |
| **toma** la primera calle | **tome** la primera calle | take the first street |
| **sube** / **baja** la calle | **suba** / **baje** la calle | go up / down the street |

Note the spelling of **cruce**: **z** becomes **c** before **e**. String the steps together with **primero**, **luego** and **al final**: *Primero sigue todo recto, luego gira a la izquierda y al final cruza la plaza: el hotel está enfrente.*

quiz.prompt: Un billete ___ a Valencia, por favor. Vuelvo mañana.
quiz.explanation: You are coming back tomorrow, so you need a return: 'un billete de ida y vuelta'. 'De ida' is a single; 'de vuelta' on its own is not how you ask.

quiz.prompt: En la estación: El tren a Sevilla sale del ___ cuatro.
quiz.explanation: Trains leave from a platform, 'el andén': 'sale del andén cuatro'. Note the accent on the é.
hints: Where you stand to wait for the train.
It is a masculine noun with an accent on the last syllable.

quiz.prompt: At the hotel reception: 'Buenas tardes. Tengo una ___ a nombre de García.'
quiz.explanation: You have a booking in your name: 'Tengo una reserva a nombre de García.' You will get the 'habitación' once they find the 'reserva'.
hints: What do you have 'in the name of' someone?
The word is close to the English 'reservation'.

quiz.prompt: Quería una ___ doble con baño para dos noches.
quiz.explanation: A hotel room is 'una habitación'; 'una habitación doble' is a double room.

quiz.prompt: ¿Está lejos el aeropuerto? — No, está ___ veinte minutos en autobús.
quiz.explanation: You express distance in time or metres with 'está a': 'está a veinte minutos'.
hints: Está ___ cinco minutos, está ___ doscientos metros.
The same little word you use for 'a la derecha'.

quiz.prompt: Give the tú command of seguir: ___ todo recto hasta el semáforo.
quiz.explanation: The tú imperative is the él/ella form of the present: seguir gives sigue. 'Sigue todo recto' = go straight on.
hints: Seguir changes e to i in the stem.
The tú command looks like the él/ella present form.

quiz.prompt: Directions to a stranger (usted): '___ a la izquierda y ___ la plaza.'
quiz.explanation: Usted commands use the subjunctive forms: girar gives gire, cruzar gives cruce (z becomes c before e). 'Gira' and 'cruza' are the tú forms.
hints: Usted commands of -ar verbs end in -e.
Both verbs must be in the same form.

quiz.prompt: El hotel está ___ de la catedral, justo al otro lado de la calle.
quiz.explanation: 'Al otro lado de la calle' (on the other side of the street) means it is opposite: 'enfrente de la catedral'.
hints: Opposite = facing it, across the street.

quiz.prompt: La farmacia está ___ la calle, en la esquina.
quiz.explanation: Location phrases end in 'de': 'al final de la calle' = at the end of the street.
hints: Al lado DE, enfrente DE, al final…

Gire a la izquierda en la primera calle.
listening.meaning: Turn left at the first street.

listening.meaning: Cross the bridge and go straight on to the station.
listening.note: New word: el puente = the bridge.

listening.text: La panadería está al final de la calle, a la derecha.
listening.meaning: The bakery is at the end of the street, on the right.
listening.note: New word: la panadería = the bakery.

guide.section: At the station and the airport

guide.tip: Not sure whether to say sigue or siga? With anyone you would call señor or señora, use the usted form: siga, gire, cruce.

conversations.title: Lost with a suitcase
conversations.scenario: Tom has just left his hotel with his suitcase and cannot find the train station. He stops Carmen in the street.

lines.speaker: a
lines.text: Perdone, ¿cómo llego a la estación de tren? Creo que me he perdido.
lines.meaning: Excuse me, how do I get to the train station? I think I'm lost.

lines.speaker: b
lines.text: No se preocupe, no está lejos. ¿Va a pie?
lines.meaning: Don't worry, it isn't far. Are you walking?

lines.speaker: a
lines.text: Sí, con la maleta, pero bueno.
lines.meaning: Yes, with the suitcase, but oh well.

lines.speaker: b
lines.text: Vale. Siga todo recto por esta calle hasta el semáforo y gire a la derecha.
lines.meaning: OK. Go straight on along this street to the traffic lights and turn right.

lines.speaker: a
lines.text: Todo recto y a la derecha en el semáforo.
lines.meaning: Straight on and right at the traffic lights.

lines.speaker: b
lines.text: Eso es. Luego cruce la plaza y la estación está al final de la calle, enfrente de un hotel grande.
lines.meaning: That's it. Then cross the square and the station is at the end of the street, opposite a big hotel.
lines.note: cruce: z becomes c · al final de · enfrente de

lines.speaker: b
lines.text: No, está a unos diez minutos. ¿A qué hora sale su tren?
lines.meaning: No, it's about ten minutes away. What time does your train leave?

lines.speaker: a
lines.text: A las once y media, y todavía tengo que comprar el billete.
lines.meaning: At half past eleven, and I still have to buy the ticket.

lines.speaker: b
lines.meaning: Then you have time. Have a good trip!

lines.speaker: a
lines.meaning: Thank you so much, very kind of you.

bites.title: Ticket talk
bites.rule: Un billete de ida = a single; de ida y vuelta = a return. The train leaves from the andén, the plane from the puerta de embarque.
bites.example: Un billete de ida y vuelta a Sevilla, por favor.
bites.example_meaning: A return ticket to Seville, please.

bites.title: Asking the way
bites.rule: Perdone, ¿cómo llego a…? or ¿dónde está…? Distance is está a + time or metres: está a cinco minutos, está a doscientos metros.
bites.example: ¿Cómo llego a la estación? — Está a diez minutos a pie.
bites.example_meaning: How do I get to the station? — It's ten minutes on foot.

bites.title: Directions are commands
bites.rule: Use the imperative: sigue / siga todo recto, gira / gire a la derecha, cruza / cruce la plaza. Tú forms for a friend, usted forms for a stranger.
bites.example: Siga todo recto y gire a la izquierda.
bites.example_meaning: Go straight on and turn left.

bites.title: Where exactly?
bites.rule: al lado de = next to, enfrente de = opposite, al final de = at the end of, en la esquina = on the corner. The place always follows de.
bites.example: El hotel está enfrente de la catedral.
bites.example_meaning: The hotel is opposite the cathedral.

sorts.title: Tú or usted?
sorts.why: Tú commands of -ar verbs end in -a (gira, cruza, toma); usted commands end in -e (gire, cruce, tome). Sigue is tú, siga is usted.

sorts.title: Station, airport or hotel?
sorts.why: Platforms and train tickets belong to the station; gates, flights and check-in to the airport; rooms, breakfast and bookings to the hotel.

sorts.title: Which little word?
sorts.why: Distance and direction take a (está a, a la derecha, a nombre de); location phrases take de (enfrente de, al final de); 'on the corner' is en la esquina.

spots.sentence: Un billete de ida y vuelva, por favor.
spots.why: A return ticket is 'de ida y vuelta'; vuelva is a command form of volver.

spots.sentence: Señor, siga todo recto y gira a la derecha.
spots.why: Señor is addressed as usted, so both commands take the usted form: siga, gire.

spots.sentence: La estación está en cinco minutos a pie.
spots.why: Distance is 'está a' + time: está a cinco minutos.

spots.sentence: El hotel está enfrente a la catedral.
spots.why: Location phrases end in de: enfrente de la catedral.
You call him señor, so you are using usted: perdone.

spots.sentence: Tengo una reserva en nombre de García.
spots.why: 'In the name of' is 'a nombre de'.
